turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_supercon_train.csv: 300 real materials, columns `composition`
    (element fractions as a compact formula string) and `target` (the
    measured critical temperature Tc (K)).
  - b3_supercon_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE materials whose critical temperature
    Tc (K) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and `composition`.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST critical
temperature Tc (K), then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training data show that the highest measured \(T_c\) values (all \(>100\,\mathrm{K}\)) belong exclusively to a small number of cuprate families: Hg-12(\(n-1\))\(n\), Tl-12(\(n-1\))\(n\), mixed Cu/Tl-12(\(n-1\))\(n\), Tl-22(\(n-1\))\(n\) and Pb-stabilized Bi-22(\(n-1\))\(n\).  All of these compositions contain Ba (or Sr for the Bi family), Ca, multiple CuO\(_2\) planes and the heavy cations Hg/Tl/Bi.

Direct compositional analogues of those high-\(T_c\) examples that appear in the candidate pool are:

- c029 (Ag,Cu)Ba\(_2\)Ca\(_3\)Cu\(_4\)O\(_{11}\) \(\leftrightarrow\) the 115 K Cu/Tl-1223 training point,
- c034 Tl\(_2\)Ba\(_2\)Ca\(_5\)Cu\(_6\)O\(_{16}\) \(\leftrightarrow\) the 110 K Tl-2223 and 108 K Tl-2212 training points,
- c046 Bi\(_{1.7}\)Pb\(_{0.2}\)Mo\(_{0.1}\)Sr\(_2\)Ca\(_2\)Cu\(_3\)O \(\leftrightarrow\) the 106 K Bi-2223 training point,
- c081 Bi\(_{3.2}\)Pb\(_{0.2}\)V\(_{0.6}\)Sr\(_4\)Ca\(_5\)Cu\(_7\)O (stoichiometry exactly double the 105 K Bi-2223-like training point),
- c097 Bi\(_{1.6}\)Pb\(_{0.4}\)Sr\(_2\)Ca\(_3\)Cu\(\approx4\)O \(\leftrightarrow\) the 103 K Bi-2234 training point.

All other families present in the pool (RE-123, 214, borocarbides, Fe-pnictides, Chevrel phases, alloys, \ldots) have training-set \(T_c\) values well below 95 K and are therefore ranked lower.  Ordering the five analogues by the \(T_c\) of their nearest training-set relatives produces the list below.

Final: c029, c034, c046, c081, c097
